item.title: Mastering Saddle Fit and Storage Solutions
item.description:
Mastering Saddle Fit and Storage Solutions

In the world of high-performance cycling and cutting-edge technology, there’s one common thread that binds leaders like Specialized and Pure Storage;

A relentless pursuit of customer satisfaction, underpinned by the confidence of a “Right-Size Guarantee”.

Though Specialized might not use this exact term, their approach screams it loud and clear. As a tech blogger for Pure Storage with a love for cycling, I’ve lived the reality of these guarantees both on the saddle and behind the screen.

Hey there Chain Reaction Challenge fans! It’s your favorite cyclist here, back with another update on our incredible journey through New Zealand and a Chain Reaction update.

Congratulations to Paul Rosham, Paul was awarded the Orange Leader jersey, sponsored by Pure Storage, and has raised $15,677 as an individual. AND over 55,000 in the time he has participated in CR events! Just an amazing amount by an individual! Congrats Paul!!

item.title: Chain Reaction Challenge Update — Day4
item.description:
Chain Reaction Challenge Update — Day4

Fox Glacier to Haast

Well, hello there cycling fans! It’s me, your friendly neighbourhood Chain Reaction cyclist, back with another update on our wild adventure through the stunning landscapes of New Zealand.

Today was day four, and we were meant to kick off with a unique start — a sunrise viewing of the Fox Glacier behind the town that shares its name.

Alas, it was not to be… the clouds had different plans for us today. So we skipped the 10km descent over gravel (plus the climb back out) to the viewing platform and instead made a beeline for Haast.

item.title: Chain Reaction Challenge Update — Day3
item.description:
Chain Reaction Challenge Update — Day3

Ross to Fox Glacier

Kia ora, fellow Chain Reaction Challenge followers! Day three Kicks off in Ross, a 50 minute bus ride from Greymouth. You couldn’t really tell the peloton had ridden 160km yesterday, the chatter on the bus was awesome, everyone was buzzing!! Reflection of yesterday and what we would see today.

Congratulations to Brett Shearer of the Pure Storage team for winning the Dynamics Projects White Jersey, awarded to the best young or new rider to Chain Reaction. Brett has impressed us all with his dedication to training and his performance on the ride, and also with his extraordinary talent for finding pies….. and as it turns out, even in remote parts of the South Island!

item.title: Chain Reaction Challenge Update — Day 1
item.description:
Chain Reaction Challenge Update — Day 1

Christchurch Prologue

The first day of the Chain Reaction Challenge has arrived, and despite the late start, the cyclists are eager to hit the road

Starting near the airport in Christchurch, the Chain Reaction peloton will make their way to Victoria Square for a traditional Māori welcome

We were welcomed by the local kaumātua, Dave and Uncle Willy, with a pōwhiri ceremony. This traditional Māori welcome involves speeches, songs, and dances to honor guests and ask for their safe passage. The ceremony typically begins with a wero, a challenge issued by a warrior to the guests to ensure their intentions are peaceful. The host then welcomes the guests with speeches, songs, and dances, and the guests are invited to respond in kind. This would normally be followed by a hongi, a pressing of noses, which symbolizes the sharing of breath and life, and is a sign of peace and friendship. However, due to the COVID-19 pandemic, we did the East Coast wave instead. The pōwhiri is an important part of Māori culture and is often performed to mark significant events, such as the arrival of visitors or the start of a journey. The blessing for a safe voyage is an integral part of the pōwhiri, as it asks for the protection of the gods and ancestors for the travelers on their journey

Day ZERO ride — warming up the legs — looking down on Lyttelton harbour

The background on why I’m doing this can be found here.

item.title: Help Mike help kids in need
item.description:
Help Mike help kids in need

The face of Chain Reaction Sydney 2023 challenge

We’re back at it….. raising funds for kids in need…….. And I NEED your HELP.

The Chain Reaction Challenge for 2023 has officially launched — and get this — Chain Reaction (reasons still unknown) has selected moi as the face, or 🤔 perhaps the beard of their Sydney event……. Not wanting to be rude, I’m backing up my inaugural 2022 ride and joining the team again for 2023. Ride on!!
